verdict.rationale: The timeouts docs let developers set an API deadline and choose how unfinished work is handled. A `return-partial` mode returns usable completed work with a completion marker, and fails without a charge if nothing usable exists. This directly lets callers trade latency for completeness. The choice between a synchronous crawl (up to 500 pages, one response) and an async background batch (up to 25K pages), plus screenshot deadlines, extends that control. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that deadlines and partial returns behave as documented, and full documentation of the other unfinished-work modes beyond `return-partial`.
